angelogia55: Jonas "Doc" Angelogia arrived at R-F22 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.

Jonas "Doc" Angelogia checked every ammunition belt by lamplight. One bad cartridge was enough to make him start the whole inspection again. A letter from home reached Jonas "Doc" Angelogia before dusk. Jonas "Doc" Angelogia read it twice and slept a little easier.
